change_scope: Only the central hub in the six-category/orbit scene. Opening, product cards, orbit geometry, offer order, timing, end card and audio remain from v11.

directions.name: Painel de marca em camadas
directions.hypothesis: An editorial, angled graphite surface with a precise rim and controlled light makes the hub feel intentional without drawing attention from product cards.
directions.brand: Official CDF logo on an untouched top tier.
directions.offer: Number or benefit keyword in large yellow type, explanatory line below; four tiny progress segments mark the current offer.
directions.motion: Short vertical type entrance and a restrained highlight sweep only when an offer changes.
directions.risk: Too much chrome around the logo.

directions.name: Tipografia suspensa
directions.hypothesis: Remove the dark capsule and let a large typographic offer float over the background, with the logo as a small header.
directions.brand: Official logo centered above the text.
directions.offer: Large type with no enclosing card.
directions.motion: Text tracks along a short vertical axis.
directions.risk: The moving product cards and red background may reduce contrast and legibility.

directions.name: Dial comercial
directions.hypothesis: A circular instrument face integrates literally with the orbit and makes the center feel like a physical dial.
directions.brand: Official logo in the dial's upper half.
directions.offer: One centered line per offer, a rotating marker points to the active segment.
directions.motion: Indicator rotates at each condition change.
directions.risk: The dial may duplicate the orbit and divert attention away from the conditions.

selection_reason: The user approved the orbit but found the center too basic. A layered editorial panel improves hierarchy and finish in that exact area while leaving the established narrative intact. The progress marker supports, rather than competes with, the offer sequence.

scenes.status: hierarchical two-line offer and quiet progress marker
